children: Token Unlocks data shows that XPL, H, SOSO, STBL, SOON, BIGTIME, ID, and MBG will see large token unlocks next week. According to PANews, Plasma (XPL) will unlock about 1.76 billion tokens at 8:00 p.m. (UTC+8) on September 25, equal to about 63.20% of its circulating supply. Humanity Protocol (H) will unlock about 266 million tokens at 8:00 a.m. (UTC+8) on September 25, equal to about 7.34% of its circulating supply. SoSoValue (SOSO) will unlock about 23.46 million tokens at 5:00 p.m. (UTC+8) on September 24, equal to about 5.97% of its circulating supply. STBL (STBL) will unlock about 210 million tokens at 6:00 p.m. (UTC+8) on September 26, equal to about 4.42% of its circulating supply. SOON (SOON) will unlock about 20.24 million tokens at 4:30 p.m. (UTC+8) on September 23, equal to about 3.62% of its circulating supply. Big Time (BIGTIME) will unlock about 333 million tokens at 8:00 a.m. (UTC+8) on September 25, equal to about 13.34% of its circulating supply. SPACE ID (ID) will unlock about 69.88 million tokens at 8:00 a.m. (UTC+8) on September 22, equal to about 4.56% of its circulating supply. MBG By MultiBank Group (MBG) will unlock about 23.6 million tokens at 8:00 p.m. (UTC+8) on September 22, equal to about 5.04% of its circulating supply.

title: Token Unlocks Data Shows Large XPL, H, and SOSO Unlocks Scheduled for Next Week
